create_typed_decorator: create a decorator that applies jaxtyping shape annotations to PyTorch functions for runtime type checking
build_tensor_type_aliases: build jaxtyping tensor type aliases for activations, tokens, logits, and attention tensors with batch and sequence dimensions
define_attention_types: define jaxtyping type aliases for queries, keys, values, cached keys, cached values, and attention masks in multi-query attention
define_recurrent_types: define jaxtyping type aliases for recurrent block states including RNN state, conv1d state, expanded activations, and reset flags
review_typed_function: review the typed decorator function that wraps PyTorch functions with optional jaxtyping runtime type checking
